title: The Spear Hero's Negotiations
paragraphs: “Does this look like it’s going to be a hassle?”
“It seems even more dangerous to force Motoyasu’s plan through. I think we should go check it out.”
“I guess we have no choice.”
Well then, let’s go meet that ‘weakest one’ for the first time in a while. As long as he acts like the weakest one and keeps his head down, I’ll make good use of him.
“Slaying a dragon, huh… It’s not impossible if we properly prepare our equipment and personnel, but it’s a tough opponent.”
“Hahaha, Panda’s a coward, isn’t he? That guy’s just a pushover.”
“I suppose that’s true for the Spear Hero.”
“Hmm… It would likely be easy for Lord Kitamura. Also, regarding the castle gate and church that Lord Kitamura ransacked…”
“Ah… come to think of it, Motoyasu-kun barged in there on his own a while back, didn’t he?”

“I’ve been instructed by the Queen herself to let it slide. But… the public’s impression isn’t very good, so please be very careful. Also, I hear the country’s monster merchant has somehow managed to resume business.”
“Monster merchant?”
“I bought up the entire stock, after all.”

I never had the slightest inkling that Filo-tan was actually Sakura-chan. So I bought as many as I could. I don’t remember much about Ren, but I’ll never forget Filolial-sama, so I’m absolutely certain.
“You said you were going shopping… With everything that’s happened, it feels like ages ago.”
Do you happen to have Luna-chan’s egg? If not, I’m curious if there’s a reason why. It might be a good idea to go look for it next time.
But… Keel and the others aren’t here. Well, there’s also the matter with Kou, after all. Let’s think about it a little more. So, with that in mind, we decided to get ready.

After setting a departure time, we decided to set out that very day. The two representatives from Siltvelt are staying behind—apparently, they still have matters to discuss at the castle. Since we never intended to have them participate in the battle anyway, that shouldn’t be a problem. Besides… we can take a decent shortcut using portals along the way. We’ll be able to make it a day trip.

Sakura-chan and the others look like they’re having a great time—they must have played to their hearts’ content in the castle gardens with their Finacées. By the way, I borrowed some wagon wheels from the castle staff to get ready for our departure.
“Have a safe trip. Everyone, please come back again.”
The Finacée is seeing us off with a cheerful expression. And Sakura-chan and the others are responding with smiles of their own.
“Yeah. We’ll be back!”
“Let’s play again!”
“We had such a wonderful time.”
They’ve become quite close in the short time I was away… What was that quick move all about? Come to think of it, we’re heading into the dragon’s territory, aren’t we?
“Father, as you surely know, Filolial-sama and the dragon don’t get along very well at all.”
“Oh, that’s right. If the dragon is still alive, it might be better to have Sakura-chan and the others wait nearby so negotiations go more smoothly…”
“Exactly.”
“Ehh…”
Sakura-chan and the others look disappointed.
“I’m sorry. It’s just that there’s a chance the dragon we’re about to meet might actually be alive. If you guys are here, things might get complicated. So please wait nearby.”
“Grrr…”
Sakura-chan looks very unhappy.
“Well, in exchange for becoming friends with Melty-chan… can you bear with it? We’ve got a lot we need to do and confirm as we move forward.”
“Booh…”

Sakura-chan nodded reluctantly, puffing out her cheeks. That’s right. Since Father and Sakura-chan got along so well, I was hoping he’d come to understand Filolial-sama just as deeply as the people of Siltvelt do—but if Sakura-chan is the very embodiment of Filolial-sama, that changes things entirely.

Ah… I’d like to introduce Father to a Filolial-sama other than Sakura-chan, someone he’s particularly close to, but that wouldn’t be fair to Sakura-chan. How on earth am I supposed to resolve this dilemma!?
“Motoyasu-kun is pulling his usual funny faces again…”
Father, having just persuaded Sakura-chan, muttered as he looked over at me. Hearing those words, I snapped back to reality.
“Well then, let’s get going—Portal Spear!”
We teleported near the village to the east.
“I think this every time, but heroes sure are convenient, aren’t they?”
“Yes, I have all sorts of trouble getting around, so this really helps.”
Zou agreed, seizing the opportunity. Well, you’re huge—and heavy, too.
“It looks like you’d have a hard time riding in a carriage, too.”
It might indeed be tough to fit this giant inside one. It might be more realistic to just have Filolial-sama pull a cart.
“Puhant, can’t you ride in vehicles?”
“I can ride on ships and stuff. Airplanes are pretty cramped, though—I had to rent the cargo hold.”
Zou replies to Kou.
“Then I want to carry Puhanto on my back! It’s payback for when you gave me a piggyback ride earlier!”
With a puff, Kou transforms into her Filolial form.
“Huh? But… I’m heavy, you know?”
“It’s fine!”
“You mustn’t underestimate the power of Filolial-sama.”
Starting with Filo-tan, Filolial-sama possess tremendous horsepower. They can easily haul even an overloaded carriage. Carrying an elephant is no big deal at all.
“Give it a try—”
Kou is wiggling her hips as she squats down, trying to get the elephant onto her back.
“O-okay. But please don’t push yourself too hard… And I’d appreciate it if you’d stop calling me by my family name.”
“Alright then, Elu.”

Satisfied with Kou’s reply, Zou nods and gently places his crotch on Kou’s back as she crouches. He seems intent on checking carefully to make sure he can lift her before putting his full weight on her.
“That’s fine.”
“Okay, Elu, I’m standing up now.”

As Kou stands up with a sudden jerk, Zou’s feet leave the ground. Zou, looking a bit uneasy, gently places a hand on Kou’s back. With Kou looking a bit small, the sight of him carrying Zou has a certain majesty to it.
But… what is it? It looks like Zou is sitting on a duck-shaped potty. This is disrespectful to Filolial-sama, to say the least, so Kou needs to get his act together!
“A-are you okay?”
“Hmm… You’re a little heavy, but I’m fine. I can run!”
With a “thump-thump-thump,” Kou, with the elephant on his back, began to run lightly.
“Whoa! Whoa… Kou, you’re amazing!”
Riding on Kou’s back as he ran around, the elephant looked surprised for a moment before speaking in a gentle voice.
“It looks like he’s straddling a potty.”
Panda heckled the scene. What’s that supposed to mean? Does he have a problem with Kou or something?
“I never thought Lars-chan would be the one to say exactly what everyone was thinking… or rather, I guess they have those things in this world too.”
Father muttered, “I actually thought Motoyasu-kun would be the one to say that.” Even Father couldn’t just let that slide.
“Father, I wouldn’t say anything disrespectful about Filolial-sama.”
“Well then, how about a ‘Filolial-style potty’?”
“I suppose there’s nothing to be done about that.”
“Your standards are… oh well. Let’s get moving soon, then.”
“Yeah… but is it really okay to go meet the dragon in this state?”
Éclair said that to us. No problem at all!

By the way, I heard Zou has some experience with motion sickness, so he didn’t seem too affected by it. And so, passing through the eastern village, we set foot in the mountain range where Rival’s parents dwell.

True enough, there’s no sign of desolation here. However, the Eastern Village, lacking financial resources, is rather deserted. By the way, there is a mountain trail for peddlers that runs from the Eastern Village near Rival parent’s nest, but apparently, it hasn’t been used since Rival parent built its nest. It’s a path that fell into disuse due to the threat of the dragon.
And so we made steady progress. Near Rival parent’s territory, we decided to have Yuki-chan and the others wait.
“I can smell a dragon from here on out—”
“Then Sakura-chan and the others will wait here, right?”
“Boo…”
“Is it really not okay for us to come along?”
Yuki-chan asked me with pleading eyes.
“It’s dangerous, and it’s only natural that things would get complicated.”
“El was just the right weight—it was fun!”
“Thank you, Kou.”

Zou climbed down from Kou and thanked him. When he got off, there was a deep rumble that shook the ground. That’s Kou for you. To save a lady’s face… he’s truly grown into a fine young man. I, Motoyasu, can’t hide my admiration for Kou’s growth.
“So, we’ll be walking from here on… but how are we going to negotiate? Can we bribe them or something?”
“It’ll be tough. In my previous loops, whenever I met a Rival’s parent, Father would handle the persuasion, but generally speaking, they won’t even listen to us.”
Plus, since we rushed here, I didn’t bring any Dragon Emperor shards for bargaining. After all, my ultimate goal is Rival himself…
“If I prove to Father that I’m completely outmatched and bring the Dragon Emperor’s Core as a bargaining chip, he’ll listen—but that would mean I’d have to start over.”
“Well, I wish you’d told me that sooner…?”
“It’ll be fine! To be honest, I was already thinking that negotiation back then might not even be necessary.”
Father’s negotiating skills are quite impressive, but when it comes to just talking to a dragon of that caliber, there’s absolutely no problem.
“Well, I’m just filled with anxiety…”
“It’ll be fine! Leave it to me!”
“Mr. Iwatani, shouldn’t we seriously stop this?”
“I think so too… He’s definitely going to mess something up.”
“R-really?”

Éclair and Panda nodded as if they were convinced, while Zou looked back and forth between me and Éclair and the others. For some reason, Éclair and Panda look just like Ren and Itsuki when they became allies, but don’t worry. I’m here—I’ve been through plenty of loops.
“HAHAHA! No problem at all! Father can just take his time climbing up! Leave it to me!”
I ran toward the dragon’s territory. Now was the perfect time to show off my signature move.
“Ah, Motoyasu-kun, wait!”
“Motoyasu! It’s Drive Mode!”

Using the wheels I borrowed from the castle, I switched to Drive Mode. It’s been a while since I transformed. Father told me last time that I should use it in an emergency, so I used it now. *Shakin’!*
“Vroom, vroom!”
“Whoa! What’s that!? You’re not just joking—you’re literally running!? That’s creepy!”
“Wow! That’s sooo cool!”
Sakura-chan is looking at me and getting all excited. It’s not quite as wild as when Filo gets excited, but I’m still happy about it.
“This is… w-wonderful…”
“Yuki-chan, you don’t have to push yourself, you know?”
“I-I’m not pushing myself at all! This must be a very efficient way to get around!”
“Whoa! I want to try that too, Kou. Brrrn-brrrn. But how do you make the wheels spin?　Is pulling a carriage more fun? I’m not really sure—”
It seems Kou is a bit overwhelmed by all the excitement. When you’re a kid, it’s easy to get confused when so many fun things happen at once.
“I wonder if Lord Kitamura is actually human?”
“A hero is probably something different from us, isn’t it?”
“If that’s the logic, then I’d be included too, so I’d have to say that’s not right.”
It seems Fathers-in-law are getting a bit worn out. Well then, I’ll go settle this quickly.
“Wheelie! Here I goooooo!”
“Hey! Motoyasu-kun, wait—”

In the blink of an eye, Father’s voice faded into the distance. I want to get out of this dragon’s territory as fast as possible, after all. Climbing slowly is a hassle. …I thought about it right after we set off, but maybe it would’ve been faster to carry Father on my back? I’ll ask him later.
So, I arrived at the spot where Rival’s parent’s corpse should be lying, and I scanned the area. Of course, I knocked out all the monsters I encountered along the way! Small fry, stay out of my way.
“You, the weakest dragon in this place! Come out here right now!　Or are you so scared of me that you’re about to wet yourself?! Pgyaaaaaa!”
Seizing the moment, I bellowed at the top of my lungs to summon Rival’s parent. Even if he’s the weakest Dragon Emperor, he’s bound to show up if I go this far.
“The fact that you’re not coming out means you’re terrified of me, don’t you know! You’re such a pathetic dragon!”
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”
With a fierce roar, Rival’s parent charged toward me with a look of rage on his face. Hahaha, to fall for such a cheap provocation—you’re just a dragon after all! HAHAHA!
“Gya!?”
For some reason, Rival’s parent stopped mid-scream when he saw me racing around in Drive Mode. What’s the matter? You’re wide open.
Time for a mode change! I switched back to my normal form and assumed a combat stance.
“Well then, let’s settle this! I’m going to knock you out, and when I do, you’d better do exactly as Father says!”
“Gyaa, Gyaaaaaaaaaaaah!”

Looking as if he had absolutely no intention of listening, Rival’s dad let out a mighty roar and lunged at me. The result… well, it goes without saying. It was a landslide victory for me. The negotiation was a success.
